description: This source file implements the HostResolverSystemTask class and related functions for DNS resolution management within the Chromium project, including task scheduling, DNS resolution logic, and override mechanisms.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask
classes.description: Manages DNS resolution tasks, including retries, logging, and callback handling.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::Create
methods.description: Creates a new HostResolverSystemTask with specified hostname, address family, flags, parameters, logging, and network handle.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::CreateForOwnHostname
methods.description: Creates a HostResolverSystemTask for resolving the local hostname.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::Start
methods.description: Begins DNS resolution process with a callback for results.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::StartLookupAttempt
methods.description: Initiates a DNS lookup attempt, possibly overriding with a custom resolver.

methods.name: HostResolverSystemTask::OnLookupComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a DNS lookup, processes results, logs, and invokes callback.
